task.description: Implement IDN-03 role-based access according to src/design/idn-03-role-based-access.md. Add centralized authorization policy evaluation with additive role union semantics and default PLATFORM_ADMIN fallback for unmapped endpoints. Enforce: TASK_WORKER-only cannot create definitions (403), TASK_WORKER+PROCESS_OPERATOR can cancel instances, and GET /tasks for TASK_WORKER applies row-level filtering (return only tasks assigned to the caller or authorized group membership) rather than 403. Integrate policy checks with API-08 authenticated principal extraction and existing identity/group data from IDN-01/IDN-02. Update code and tests as needed, preserving existing API contracts unless the design explicitly changes them.
acceptance_criteria: IDN-03 acceptance criteria are fully implemented in backend code
Authorization is centralized with additive role semantics and explicit default behavior
GET /tasks for TASK_WORKER performs row-level filtering instead of endpoint denial
Unsupported role actions return HTTP 403 with consistent error mapping

result.summary: Implemented IDN-03 centralized RBAC policy evaluation with additive role semantics and default PLATFORM_ADMIN fallback; integrated policy-based checks into task operations and added TASK_WORKER GET /tasks row-level filtering for own assignments plus authorized group membership.
